n = 3010
mod = 10**9 + 7
f = [1] + [0] * n
g = [1] + [0] * n

for i in range(1, n):
    f[i] = f[i - 1] * i % mod
    g[i] = pow(f[i], mod - 2, mod)


class Solution:
    def makeStringSorted(self, s: str) -> int:
        cnt = Counter(s)
        ans, n = 0, len(s)
        for i, c in enumerate(s):
            m = sum(v for a, v in cnt.items() if a < c)
            t = f[n - i - 1] * m
            for v in cnt.values():
                t = t * g[v] % mod
            ans = (ans + t) % mod
            cnt[c] -= 1
            if cnt[c] == 0:
                cnt.pop(c)
        return ans
